messages:
Lena H: quick check-in 1: were planning a cross-region perf sweep tomorrow 03:00 UTC. need 4x H100 in eu-west1 and 4x H100 in asia-south1 for synchronized allreduce tests. can procurement confirm vendor availability and whether firmware/drivers match? :mag:
Marco T: reserved preferred. if not possible, we can do a mixed fallback (6x H100 + 2x L40) but we'd like firmware parity for NCCL stability.
Sophie Y: last time we hit a mismatched microcode and got hangs on large-batch allreduce. vendor must confirm `driver_version` and `firmware_build` or we'll require a shim.
infra-bot: quota snapshot: eu-west1 h100: 10 used / 16 soft quota. asia-south1 h100: 1 used / 8 soft quota. requested +8 will exceed eu-west1 soft quota; project carve or temporary bump needed.
Lena H: @procurement-bot please ask vendor for exact FW list and whether they can patch to `h100-2024-05-01` by T-12h. include billing tag `eo-q2-sweep` on the PO.
procurement-bot: created draft PO #PO-9405. awaiting finance. vendor contacted, holding resources for 24h on provisional terms. please attach exact terraform claim to speed approval.
Marco T: sample draft for PR (paste into infra PR):
```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_reservation" "eo_crossregion" {
  region = "eu-west1"
  model  = "h100"
  count  = 4
  duration_hours = 3
  tags = ["eo-q2-sweep"]
  metadata = { driver_version = "530.30" firmware_build = "h100-2024-05-01" }
}
resource "redwood_gpu_reservation" "eo_crossregion_apac" {
  region = "asia-south1"
  model  = "h100"
  count  = 4
  duration_hours = 3
  tags = ["eo-q2-sweep"]
}
```
oncall-lee: add an `accept_fallback` flag so procurement can auto-approve mixed allocations if vendor cancels within T-12h. also include a KV-cache prewarm script in PR.
Sophie Y: i'll prepare a small compatibility shim that detects driver mismatch and switches to NCCL fallback. add `compat_mode = "shim-v1"` in the test harness.
Lena H: sounds good. final asks:
- @procurement-bot expedite PO-9405 with billing_entity=rw-eoq2
- infra oncall to prepare quota carve if eu-west1 bump needed
- Sophie to post shim + perf note here by EOD
procurement-bot: finance approved PO-9405 at 2024-05-10T12:45Z. vendor confirmed provisional hold; they will post firmware manifest by 2024-05-10T18:00Z.
Lena H: perfect. i'll update the runbook and link the infra PR when ready. thanks everyone. :rocket:
